Verb. 1 • être propre, pur; clean; pure. Amnatu lonnii kaddule muuɗum faa laaɓi. Amnatou a lavé ses habits jusqu’à ce qu'ils étaient propre. The various adj. forms of laaɓude are: Group I ɓe/laaɓ(u)ɓe, ko1/laaɓ(u)ko, nde/ laaɓunde, ndu/laaɓundu, nge/laaɓunge, ngo/laaɓungo Group II ɗe/laaɓ(u)ɗe, ɗi/laaɓ(u)ɗi, ɗum/laaɓ(u)ɗum, kal/laaɓ(u)kal, kol/laaɓ(u)kol, ngal/laaɓungal, ngel/laaɓungel, ngol/laaɓungol, o/laaɓ(u)ɗo Group III ɗam/laaɓ(u)ɗam, ka/laaɓ(u)ka, ki/laaɓ(u)ki, ko2/laaɓ(u)ko, koy/laaɓ(u)koy, ndi/laaɓundi, nga/laaɓunga, ngi/laaɓungi, ngu/laaɓungu Note: the main base form for these adjectives is laaɓ(u) (the "u" is usually dropped except before a "n"), but there is a second pattern than can be used for all but the o noun class: laam- + noun class marker - in particular they like to use this before "ng"; e.g. nagge laamnge, puccu laamngu. compare: jalbude, la'aade; synonyms: cubinaade, dartaade, fonnditaade, fooccaade, hegitaade, henngitaade, laamnude, senaade. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

lagaade   Noun Form of Infinitive: lagagol. Participles: sing: lagiiɗo-lagotooɗo plur: lagiiɓe-lagotooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. Verb Stative or Progressive: st/prg. Verb. 1 • grimper, monter sur /dans sans pouvoir descendre; climb into. Yuusufi ƴeenyii dow manngoy de lagii dow ton. Youssouf est monté sur un manguier mais il est coincé là-haut. Yusuufi climbed up the mango but got stuck up there. ***: fakaade, ɗagaade, horude, ɗanngude, ɗaggude; synonyms: ɗaggude, ɗanngude, horude. Dialects: G.

2 • enlever qqch d'un trou; remove something from a hole. Muusa, taa laga nyiiri ndi. Moussa, ne fais pas un tunnel dans ton tô. Muusa, don't make a tunnel in the nyiiri. What is meant is that Muusa has started creating a "hole' in the side of a lump of "nyiiri" and he has enlarged the hole so much that it is as if he is reaching into the center of the lump. Dialects: J.

3 • avoir un os ou une épine coincée dans la gorge; to have a bone or a thorn stuck in your throat. Nagge ƴakkii ƴiire de lagii. Le bœuf a mangé l'os mais il est resté coincé dans sa gorge. The cow chewed the bone, but it got stuck in its throat. Dialects: Y.

4 • mettre un mors dans la bouche d'un animal (cheval ou bœuf); in the case of a horse it is to direct; in the case of a cow it acts more like a gag to keep them from eating; to place a bit in an animals mouth. Adaama lagii naggem taa nyaama gawri muuɗum. Adama a mis un mors dans la bouche de son bœuf ainsi il ne mange pas son mil. Adaama gaged his cow so it doesn't eat his grain. compare: yonngaade. 2 • rebeller ou se révolter contre; revolt against; rebel. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

3 • s'opposer, ne pas être d'accord; disagree. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

4 • se coucher avec la tête au bout de pieds, se mettre a l'envers; lie down. synonyms: sintaade. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

5 • être à travers, renversé, dessus dessous; turned upside down. synonyms: sintaade; compare: yankirde, luttude. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

lunndude   Noun Form of Infinitive: lunndude. Participles: sing: lunnduɗo-lunndoowo plur: lunnduɓe-lunndooɓe. Sorting Designation: 4. Verb Stative or Progressive: st/prg.
